name: Coca-Cola Consolidated - Roanoke Production Center, VA

fieldNotes.locationCorrection: Roster address 2001 Towne Square Blvd NW is a retail/mall address (Valley View area) — wrong site. The actual Coca-Cola Consolidated Roanoke production/distribution facility is at 235 Shenandoah Ave NW, Roanoke VA 24016 (37.27386, -79.94698). Audited at the corrected location.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fence fully encloses the trailer yard along the public road; a driveway gate provides controlled entry. No formal guard booth structure is visible in satellite or Street View — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth identified at the entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true: a fenced controlled entry without a visible staffed booth implies kiosk / remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Very extensive on-site trailer yard — diagonal trailer stalls fill the center/west of the property, ~70 trailers visible (many are Red Classic, Coca-Cola Consolidated's logistics fleet).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple connected/adjacent buildings: main production building plus warehouse/ancillary structures on a campus.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks on the production/warehouse building faces, estimated ~30 doors; approximate.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail yard runs south of the property but no clear spur enters the Coca-Cola facility.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense urban industrial setting in the city of Roanoke.
